components.title: Toast
components.summary: Notification messages that auto-dismiss

<!-- Toasts are created dynamically via EventBus -->
eventBus.publish('INTENT_TOAST_SHOW', {
    type: 'success',
    title: 'Deployment succeeded',
    description: 'The runtime bootstrap completed without contract violations.',
    duration: 2800,
    timestamp: Date.now()
});
